_doc: CNTFET transistor counts per ternary cell. Variants are the three inverter/NAND styles tabulated by Etiemble, arXiv:1908.06841 (2019) Tables II/III, and the mux cells of Etiemble arXiv:2101.01516 (2021) Table III. CONST1 = Vdd/2 rail (0T, needs 2nd supply) or 2T divider (static power). Values 0=-,1=0,2=+ in our encoding; Etiemble uses 0,1,2 unbalanced but cell costs are representation-independent.

lin2011.source: Lin, Kim & Lombardi, IEEE TNANO 10(2):217-225, 2011 (via Etiemble 2019 [6])

sharifi2015.source: Sharifi et al., Microelectronics J. 2015 (via Etiemble 2019 [5])

younepal2011.source: You & Nepal, Micro & Nano Letters 2011 (via Etiemble 2019 [8]); two supplies + dc path
